primary_task: Configure, for one integration, how Synder finds the existing invoice a payment belongs to — and understand what will happen when it finds nothing.

not_exercised.reason: prototype chrome for demoing environment states, not product UI — excluded from review scope

controls.label: Apply payments to invoices (toggle)
controls.after_interaction: off → the Payment application row gains "Turn on Apply payments to invoices first"; Configure stays enabled

controls.label: Cancel sync if there is no matching open invoice found for a payment (toggle)
controls.after_interaction: shared value; reopening the overlay shows the same state

controls.label: Configure / Edit rule (button, opens overlay modal)
controls.after_interaction: opens the full-screen overlay; closing via Save/Cancel/Escape returns to GSP and the button is still clickable

controls.label: plan gate (Starter)
controls.after_interaction: Configure disabled: true; states "Available on Pro, Pro Max and Premium": true

controls.label: ✕ close / Cancel / Save / Escape
controls.after_interaction: Cancel and Escape discard edits; Save persists and closes; footer message states the blocking-error count

controls.label: Use a custom rule for this integration
controls.after_interaction: false → true → false; off hides sections 1-3 and shows the default-matcher reference card

controls.label: are for the same customer as the payment
controls.after_interaction: true → false → true

controls.label: are dated within N days either side of the payment (toggle, admin-gated off)
controls.after_interaction: not admin-enabled: click does nothing (true → true); a lock glyph sits beside the toggle and a hint explains why. With the admin flag on, it turns off and shows "No date limit".

controls.label: Days either side (number input)
controls.after_interaction: 45 → row label reads "are dated within 45 days either side of the payment", window "2026-04-30 → 2026-07-29"; 999 clamps to 365. Commits on change, not on every keystroke.

controls.label: have an invoice number that <op> the payment's <source> (toggle)
controls.after_interaction: true → false → true

controls.label: Take the value from (source)
controls.after_interaction: value invoice_number → payment_meta → invoice_number; Save button still visible: true

controls.label: Comparison (4 pushable operands only)
controls.after_interaction: value eq → contains → eq; Save button still visible: true

controls.label: Compare against (locked target)
controls.after_interaction: not editable; reads "Invoice number" with a lock glyph and a title attribute explaining why

controls.label: Metadata key (text input, conditional)
controls.after_interaction: renders only when the source needs a key; blank blocks Save (true) with "Enter the metadata key to match on."; typing does not re-render (focus stays on c-mkey)

controls.label: scope validity guard + customer inheritance
controls.after_interaction: Customer off reveals the inheritance checkbox (true) and blocks Save until it is checked (true); both bounding rows off blocks Save (true) with "Keep either Customer or the invoice-number match on — otherwise Synder has to look at every invoice in your books."

controls.label: On the payment (condition source)
controls.after_interaction: value invoice_note → payment_meta → invoice_note; Save button still visible: true

controls.label: Comparison (all 10 operands)
controls.after_interaction: value eq → ncontains → eq; Save button still visible: true

controls.label: On the invoice (target)
controls.after_interaction: value private_note → doc_number → private_note; Save button still visible: true

controls.label: ALL of these / ANY of these (segmented control)
controls.after_interaction: switching updates the inline joiner between rows (AND → OR); with one row the control has no visible effect

controls.label: + Add condition / ✕ remove row
controls.after_interaction: add → 2 rows; removing the last row replaces the box with an explanation that the payment goes to the first invoice found. Rows carry no reorder affordance (row order is intentionally not a combinator).

controls.label: Apply as overpayment
controls.after_interaction: true → false → true

controls.label: Cancel sync if there is no matching open invoice found for a payment (same value as GSP)
controls.after_interaction: false → true → false

controls.label: In plain terms
controls.after_interaction: opens on click; survives a full re-render (false); closes on a second click

controls.label: The exact request Synder will send to QuickBooks
controls.after_interaction: opens on click; survives a full re-render (true); closes on a second click

controls.label: Try it on a sample payment
controls.after_interaction: opens on click; survives a full re-render (true); closes on a second click

controls.label: sample payment cards (simulator)
controls.after_interaction: 4 cards; selecting one re-runs the engine and prints the outcome, the candidate table and a step log. Cards are divs, not radios.

facts.no_limit_warning: No date limit. With this row off, invoices of any age are considered. On a large ledger that means a much longer list to search and a slower sync.
facts.overlay_header: ✕ Payment application Stripe — mzkt.by · QuickBooks Online · applies to this integration only Default matching

simulator_outcomes.simple_charge: No match — Processed as usual, as no open invoice was found. The default matcher is not consulted at any point.
simulator_outcomes.overpayment: Applied — Applied to INV-1042 as an overpayment — the payment ($400.00) is more than the INV-1042 due ($259.50) and “Apply as overpayment” is on.

facts.days_field_commit_without_blur_first: Typing 45 into 'Days either side' and clicking Save directly commits on the first click (overlay closes, value persists as 45, row label rereads '45 days'). The change handler re-renders #ov-body, but Save lives in the footer outside it, so the button node is not replaced mid-click.
